description: Sets the absolute measurement for the horizontal positioning of the floating object.

params.description: The document element which will be taken as a countdown point for the object horizontal alignment.
params.name: sRelativeFrom

params.description: The distance from the right side of the document element to the floating object. Use EMU for absolute distance or a number for percent (1 = 1%) when bPercent=true.
params.name: nDistance

params.description: The option defining whether the horizontal alignment offset is specified in percent.
params.name: bPercent

signature: SetHorPosition(sRelativeFrom: RelFromH, nDistance: EMU | number, bPercent?: boolean): boolean
